name: Local Sonar gate adopted 2026-07-15: baseline 399 standing findings
description: The .sonar-local/ rig (pinned sonarqube:26.3.0.120487-community, port 19244, profile 'OPA-ABAC Local Java' = owned copy of built-in Sonar way) became the repo's static-analysis gate on branch feature/void3110/sonar-local-gate. Full-tree baseline at adoption: 399 open findings, dominated by S8445 x116, S5778 x67, S7467 x42 (largely test-code rules), then S1192/S5853/S5838/S125/S2160/S6068/S1186 ~10 each. These PRE-DATE the gate: the per-ticket signal is changed-files-only (sonar-local.sh default, diff vs origin/main), so the standing set does not block tickets. Triage of the baseline (fix vs mark-by-design-FP, recorded in this domain) is queued follow-up work, mirroring the IDP SONAR-SMELL-BACKLOG effort. No by-design FPs are documented yet - until triage happens, judge each finding on merits.
